newsitem.title: UK: ScotAm receives three firm initial offers.
newsitem.headline: ScotAm receives three firm initial offers.

text.p: Britain's Scottish Amicable said on Friday it had received firm initial offers from Abbey National, Prudential Corp and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP).
ScotAm is to continue discussions with the three companies wuith a view to obtaining final offers by mid-March.
ScotAm said none of the potential acquirers had asked it to make details of the proposals public at this stage.

"The receipt of these three firm proposals represents an excellent outcome to this phase of the process. We can now move on to the next phase with every expectation of delivering maximum value to policyholders," said ScotAm chairman Sandy Stewart.
ScotAm said it would not express an opinion on the merits or otherwise of any proposal until the evaluation process was complete.
Last week ScotAm asked for firm offers for the company by noon today. It said then it would recommend a single proposal to policyholders by the end of March.
